note: TR-62-004. Interview with R. D. Pruitt, 09 NOV 1962. ONBA reel, dubbed 1996.
segments: Mister Pruitt. How many people did you admit to the shelter, on the night of the twenty-seventh?
I know what it says. I wrote it.
I don't know why I wrote it.
The sign on the door says fourteen.
That's right. Fourteen. That's the rule.
I did. I closed the door.
That's the warden's job. You count them in. And you close the door.
Was anyone outside, when you closed it?
Mister Pruitt. Do you have any children?
No, sir. My wife and I, we.
There's a girl's bicycle in your garage.
I'd like you to go now.
I'd like you to go now.
